patterns.prevention:
• Assign a primary and backup coach to each centre before the start date, with written confirmation of availability for the full program term.

• Conduct weekly consistency checks during the first month—verify the same coach is delivering sessions and document any changes immediately.

• Create a coach replacement protocol that requires 48-hour notice to parents and at least one transition session where both coaches are present.

• Require centres to confirm coach schedules in writing at weeks 1, 4, and 8, with escalation to state manager if any gaps appear.
